items.title: Experian Finds Young Australians Avoid Applying for Credit
items.why: Young consumers avoiding credit applications signals a long-term acquisition gap for card products.
items.summary_ai: Experian research finds young Australians are reluctant to apply for credit products.
items.take: Young consumers avoiding credit applications signals a long-term acquisition gap for card products.

items.title: Young Australians shy away from credit applications: Experian
items.why: Reduced credit application appetite among young consumers is a signal to watch for future card acquisition, though this is an Australian market.

items.title: Experian Unveils Cashflow Data Bureau to Power Smarter Lending in the UK
items.why: Cashflow-based underwriting data could sharpen card and personal loan decisions; it is UK-only for now, so watch for US equivalents.
items.summary_ai: Experian launched a UK cashflow data bureau designed to support more informed lending decisions.
